text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Oguri-chan. How have things been 
lately? Are you... having any troubles?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...No, nothing in particular. Why do you 
ask?"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I wonder why? ...Maybe it's because I 
feel like we're a bit alike?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Just like you, I also came from the 
countryside, and so many... countlessly 
many people have given me their support...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"...There was a lot on my mind. I was just 
wondering if Oguri-chan is doing okay."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I don't really understand, but I'm fine. 
—You were the same way, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hearing so many cheers makes me happy and 
gives me strength. The louder they get, 
the more I can dig deep... If you're like 
me, you must have felt the same.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu, I see. You really are an 'Idol 
Umamusume' to the core, too."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
? No, I am not an idol. You're the idol 
here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it, I had a problem. 
I'm performing at a live event soon."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...I want to make everyone smile, just 
like you. Could you teach me how?"

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course! Let's reach their hearts, 
share our gratitude... and become one with 
the fans♪
